Ours: SPICE (spiceypy) with naif0012.tls: Ours: SPICE (spiceypy) with naif0012.tls, de440s.bsp, pck00011.tpc, moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc and moon_de440_250416.tf. Apparent (LT+S) Sun and Earth positions from the Moon's centre in MOON_ME (DE440 mean-Earth frame), computed once hourly; per site the observer vector (sphere 1737.4 km + elevation) is subtracted and projected on local east/north/up (azimuth from north, clockwise). Reference: JPL Horizons API, OBSERVER table from a geodetic lunar surface site (coord@301), QUANTITIES=4 (airless apparent azimuth/elevation, DE441, MEAN_ME high precision). 3 sites x 10 instants (2026-11 to 2028-12) x Sun and Earth; d_az is circular.
